collection_date_original_note: 90 rows, all from one post, store collection_date_original as '7/23/2026 7:50' while collection_date is an ISO timestamp of the same minute. After parsing, every matched key agrees with the raw collection timestamp to the minute.
sampling_note: About 22.7% of comments are annotated, and every post is represented at roughly 22–23%. The gap between annotated rows is not a single fixed stride. No sampling protocol is stored in the project files, so the design cannot be confirmed.
overlap_note: The 1,199 annotated records are a matched subset of the 5,292 raw comments. They are not a separate population.
